sourceSnapshots.retrievalMethod: HTTP byte ranges; each CBA header and downloaded chunk verified by BLAKE2b

limitations: Source snapshots are recorded per image: 90 renders from the pinned November 2024 official installer and 5 from the official current updater release ci-38925666467-1.
These are renders of original client geometry, skeletons, textures, idle poses and equipped parts. They are not in-game screenshots.
Neutral presentation lighting; game environment reflections, bloom/aura, particle effects and unparsed ZSC2 EMIS effects are omitted.
Each portrait is framed independently; real relative model scale is recorded separately in scalePercent.

records.renderNote: Oryginalny model i tekstury klienta (11.2024), neutralne światło. Aura i efekty cząsteczkowe pominięte.
limitations: Original model geometry, material textures, skeleton, idle pose and equipped model parts from the public Global installer snapshot of November 2024.

The pinned 2024 client does not establish changes in the live 2026 game.
Portrait framing fits each creature to the same canvas; real relative monster sizes are recorded separately in scalePercent.

definitionComparison.result: Catalog names, NPC/CHR IDs, body-part IDs, skeleton and idle paths, scale, equipped-weapon IDs and glow definitions agree with the pinned 2024 snapshot.

bodyMaterialChanges.change: Head alpha test disabled in current client; render replaced with current-client version.
Body03_02 alpha threshold changed from 128 to 200; render replaced with current-client version.

definitionComparison.notes: Effect index renumbering retains resolved effect paths and dummy attachments. Combat-level differences are outside this appearance comparison.
definitionComparison.scopeLimit: Definition/reference comparison does not establish binary identity of every geometry, skeleton, animation or weapon asset.

bodyTextureComparison.scopeLimit: Body textures only; weapon textures are not included. Equality is for the decoded base image, not every mip level or container byte.
